title: Option to show the job progress percentage next to the notification icon in the system tray
line: A new "Show percentage on icon" option in the Notifications settings shows running jobs' progress as a number on the tray icon.
explanation: While a job runs, the Notifications tray icon draws a progress ring with the number of running jobs inside it; the percentage itself was only in the tooltip and popup, and the ring is hard to read at tray size. The widget has no settings page of its own (Configure opens the Notifications KCM). The change adds a Jobs/PercentageOnIcon setting (off by default) to libnotificationmanager, a "Show percentage on icon" checkbox under Application progress in the Notifications KCM, and when it is on the tray icon shows the combined percentage inside the ring instead of the job count.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: add option to show job percentage on the icon

While jobs run, the tray icon only showed a ring and the number of jobs,
and the ring is hard to read at tray size. Add a "Show percentage on
icon" option to the Notifications page that draws the percentage instead.

BUG: 526873

patches.diff:
From c4d759ddd68bc2d0055b0280684f7581fff21802 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 19:09:10 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: add option to show job percentage on
 the icon

While jobs run, the tray icon only showed a ring and the number of jobs,
and the ring is hard to read at tray size. Add a "Show percentage on
icon" option to the Notifications page that draws the percentage instead.

BUG: 526873
---
 applets/notifications/CompactRepresentation.qml |  3 ++-
 applets/notifications/main.qml                  |  1 +
 kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml                  | 16 ++++++++++++++++
 libnotificationmanager/kcfg/jobsettings.kcfg    |  3 +++
 libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp             | 14 ++++++++++++++
 libnotificationmanager/settings.h               |  7 +++++++
 6 files changed, 43 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/notifications/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/notifications/CompactRepresentation.qml
index 16b47a3002..6b7371e18c 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -28,6 +28,7 @@ MouseArea {
 
     property int jobsCount: 0
     property int jobsPercentage: 0
+    property bool showJobsPercentage: false
 
     property bool inhibited: false
 
@@ -109,7 +110,7 @@ MouseArea {
             when: compactRoot.jobsCount > 0
             PropertyChanges {
                 notificationIcon.source: "notification-progress-inactive"
-                countLabel.text: compactRoot.jobsCount
+                countLabel.text: compactRoot.showJobsPercentage && compactRoot.jobsPercentage > 0 ? compactRoot.jobsPercentage : compactRoot.jobsCount
                 countLabel.visible: true
                 busyIndicator.visible: compactRoot.jobsPercentage == 0
                 chart.visible: true
diff --git a/applets/notifications/main.qml b/applets/notifications/main.qml
index 8d98753eca..38c997d857 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/main.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/main.qml
@@ -156,6 +156,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
         jobsCount: historyModel.activeJobsCount
         jobsPercentage: historyModel.jobsPercentage
+        showJobsPercentage: notificationSettings.jobPercentageOnIcon
 
         inhibited: root.inhibitedOrBroken
     }
diff --git a/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml b/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml
index 83dc77275c..43dfe01cef 100644
--- a/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml
+++ b/kcms/notifications/ui/main.qml
@@ -348,6 +348,22 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             }
         }
 
+        RowLayout { // just for indentation
+            QtControls.CheckBox {
+                Layout.leftMargin: mirrored ? 0 : indicator.width
+                Layout.rightMargin: mirrored ? indicator.width : 0
+                text: i18nc("@option:check Show combined job progress as a percentage on the notification icon", "Show percentage on icon")
+                checked: kcm.jobSettings.percentageOnIcon
+                onClicked: kcm.jobSettings.percentageOnIcon = checked
+
+                KCM.SettingStateBinding {
+                    configObject: kcm.jobSettings
+                    settingName: "PercentageOnIcon"
+                    extraEnabledConditions: applicationJobsEnabledCheck.checked
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
         QtControls.CheckBox {
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18n("Notification badges:")
             text: i18n("Show in task manager")
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/jobsettings.kcfg b/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/jobsettings.kcfg
index af8bcd299f..c460060c57 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/jobsettings.kcfg
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/kcfg/jobsettings.kcfg
@@ -12,6 +12,9 @@
         <entry name="PermanentPopups" type="Bool">
             <default>true</default>
         </entry>
+        <entry name="PercentageOnIcon" type="Bool">
+            <default>false</default>
+        </entry>
     </group>
 
 </kcfg>
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp b/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp
index 9e0da288ab..c59cfa774f 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/settings.cpp
@@ -469,6 +469,20 @@ void Settings::setPermanentJobPopups(bool enable)
     d->setDirty(true);
 }
 
+bool Settings::jobPercentageOnIcon() const
+{
+    return d->jobSettings.percentageOnIcon();
+}
+
+void Settings::setJobPercentageOnIcon(bool enable)
+{
+    if (jobPercentageOnIcon() == enable) {
+        return;
+    }
+    d->jobSettings.setPercentageOnIcon(enable);
+    d->setDirty(true);
+}
+
 bool Settings::badgesInTaskManager() const
 {
     return d->badgeSettings.inTaskManager();
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/settings.h b/libnotificationmanager/settings.h
index 82eb89d055..3c7b026fdf 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/settings.h
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/settings.h
@@ -75,6 +75,10 @@ class NOTIFICATIONMANAGER_EXPORT Settings : public QObject
      * Whether application jobs stay visible for the whole duration of the job
      */
     Q_PROPERTY(bool permanentJobPopups READ permanentJobPopups WRITE setPermanentJobPopups /*RESET resetAutoHideJobsPopup*/ NOTIFY settingsChanged)
+    /**
+     * Whether the combined progress of application jobs is shown as a percentage on the notification icon
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(bool jobPercentageOnIcon READ jobPercentageOnIcon WRITE setJobPercentageOnIcon NOTIFY settingsChanged)
 
     /**
      * Whether to show notification badges (numbers in circles) in task manager
@@ -293,6 +297,9 @@ public:
     bool permanentJobPopups() const;
     void setPermanentJobPopups(bool enable);
 
+    bool jobPercentageOnIcon() const;
+    void setJobPercentageOnIcon(bool enable);
+
     bool badgesInTaskManager() const;
     void setBadgesInTaskManager(bool enable);
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Current master, one job at 47%: the tray icon shows the ring with the job count 1 inside
With the option on: the ring shows 47
The new checkbox in System Settings > Notifications, under Application progress
Two jobs at 47% and 13%: the icon shows the combined 30%, the same value the ring uses
